Every turn of such a session runs in the agent CLI on the DSH machin","id":"gh:1440803278","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-aio-agent","slug":"cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent","topics":["agents","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Run sessions in Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, CodeBuddy or Kimi Code from inside DeepSeek Ha"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"rness (DSH). Each agent appears as a mode in the mode menu, and its models appear in the native mode"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"l selector. Every turn of such a session runs in the agent CLI on the DSH machin"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Run sessions in Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, CodeBuddy or Kimi Code from inside DeepSeek Ha"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"rness (DSH). Each agent appears as a mode in the mode menu, and its models appear in the native mode"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"l selector. Every turn of such a session runs in the agent CLI on the DSH machine. Cursor, Claude Co"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"de, Codex, OpenCode and CodeBuddy run one process per turn in their JSON stream mode (`cursor-agent "},{"id":"p4s5","text":"--print`, `claude -p`, `codex exec --json`, `opencode run --format json`, `codebuddy --print`), whic"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"h reports token usage and resumes the CLI's own session by id; Kimi Code runs over the Agent Client "},{"id":"p4s7","text":"Protocol (ACP). DSH only renders the conversation and keeps the session log; it never calls its own "},{"id":"p4s8","text":"model for these sessions."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Open **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `github:cocofhu/dsh-aio-agent`, choose **Install**, then **Enab"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"le now**. From a terminal, the same install is:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"A release tarball (`cocofhu-dsh-aio-agent-<version>.tgz`, built with `npm pack`) installs the same w"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ay by its path or URL. To upgrade, uninstall the plugin and install the new version; settings stay i"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" or URL. To upgrade, uninstall the plugin and install the new version; settings stay in the profile."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Then install and sign in to the agents you want, on the machine that runs DSH:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Agent | Install | Sign in |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Cursor | `curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS \| bash` | `cursor-agent login` |
| Claude Code | `"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code` | `claude auth login` |
| Codex | `npm install -g @openai/"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"codex` | `codex login` |
| OpenCode | `npm install -g opencode-ai` | `opencode auth login` |
| CodeB"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"uddy | `npm install -g @tencent-ai/codebuddy-code` | run `codebuddy`, then `/login`; models in `~/.c"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"odebuddy/models.json` need no sign-in |
| Kimi Code | `curl -fsSL https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/in"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"stall.sh \| bash` | `kimi acp --login` |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"An agent that is not installed or not signed in stays out of the model selector instead of showing a"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"n error. Its settings page shows the steps above with copy buttons."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Use"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"1. Pick **Cursor**, **Claude Code**, **Codex**, **OpenCode**, **CodeBuddy** or **Kimi Code** from th"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"e mode menu of a new session.
2. Choose one of that agent's models in the model selector, or keep it"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"s default. Where the agent offers reasoning levels (Codex, OpenCode variants, Kimi Code thinking), p"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"ick one under **Reasoning effort**; Codex lists the models and levels of its own picker (`~/.codex/m"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"odels_cache.json`).
3. Send messages as usual. Replies stream in as the agent writes them. Queued me"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ssages run in order after the current turn. Send on a queue row interrupts the current CLI call and "},{"id":"p14s7","text":"resumes the same CLI session with that message. Stop cancels the active call and its tool processes,"},{"id":"p14s8","text":" keeping pending input queued until you send again. Tool calls show up as native shell, read, write "},{"id":"p14s9","text":"g input queued until you send again. Tool calls show up as native shell, read, write and edit steps."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The CLI keeps its own conversation context: each turn resumes the CLI session the first turn started"},{"id":"p15s2","text":", also after a DSH restart."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Type `/` to run a skill from this workspace or your home directory. Skills are read from `.dsh/skill"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"s`, `.agents/skills`, `.claude/skills`, `.claude/commands`, `.cursor/skills`, `.codex/skills`, `.ope"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ncode/skills`, `.codebuddy/skills` and `.kimi/skills` (project, then the same directories under your"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" home directory). Choosing `/skill-name` highlights the chip and opens its `SKILL.md` in the sidebar"},{"id":"p16s5","text":". Sending it includes the skill instructions in the prompt the CLI receives, including for an agent "},{"id":"p16s6","text":"that does not scan that directory itself. A skill the CLI loads with its own Skill tool shows as the"},{"id":"p16s7","text":" native expandable skill card."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"`/resume` continues a CLI session that already exists on this machine. The popup lists the current w"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"orkspace first, then other workspaces, with the title, time and a short id. `/resume <session-id>` b"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"inds that id directly. Later turns pass it to the CLI (`--resume`, `codex exec resume`, `opencode ru"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"n --session`, or ACP `session/load` for Kimi Code). DSH keeps its own transcript; it does not copy t"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"he CLI's history. After a resume, the transcript shows a resume card, a bar above the composer stays"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" visible with that session's title, and the sidebar title changes to it."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Configure"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**Plugins → AIO Agent** lists one switchable component per agent; switching one off removes its mode"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" and its models. **Configure** opens the agent's page:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **Status**: ready with its model count, or the install and sign-in steps when DSH cannot start it."},{"id":"p20s2","text":" **Check again** re-reads it.
- **Default model**: used until a session picks a model.
- **Launch co"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"mmand**: replaces the built-in executable, e.g. `"/opt/Cursor Agent/cursor-agent"` or `/opt/codex --"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"profile work`; options after it are kept. Quote paths that contain spaces.
- **Approve permission re"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"quests**: answers the requests the agent sends before acting, such as running a command. On approves"},{"id":"p20s6","text":", off declines. Actions the agent takes without asking follow its own settings."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Saved values go to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and apply from the next turn, without a reload."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Session log"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Every line of a JSON stream is recorded in the session log as `plugin:dsh-aio-agent/stream`, and eve"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ry ACP frame in both directions as `plugin:dsh-aio-agent/acp`, with secrets redacted. Permission ans"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"wers are recorded as `plugin:dsh-aio-agent/permission`, and the binding between a DSH session and it"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"s CLI session as `plugin:dsh-aio-agent/binding`."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- Codex and OpenCode report each reply and tool call once it is complete, so their text arrives in w"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"hole messages rather than token by token.
- A Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode session begun with an e"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"arlier version of this plugin, over ACP, continues in a new CLI session; its DSH transcript stays.
-"},{"id":"p25s4","text":" The composer's access mode does not restrict the external agent.
- The status cannot tell an agent "},{"id":"p25s5","text":"that is not installed from one that is not signed in."}],"truncated":true}
